# Syntyr CSS

> MIT-licensed CSS-first interface system for accessible SaaS, business, and futuristic interfaces. No required JavaScript, build tool, or runtime dependencies. Read release boundaries before generating markup.

The **published immutable release** is v0.3.0-alpha.4 (Grid, Noir, Studio). The main branch currently represents an **unreleased v0.3.0-alpha.5 candidate** with additional themes and modules. Documentation follows current source unless it explicitly refers to the published tag; verify availability against the version you actually install.

## Choose the right representation

For browser readers, use the [human-readable HTML documentation directory](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/reference.html) and [practical HTML guides](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/guides.html). For retrieval by coding agents, the links below point to public Markdown source files with the same guide content. Markdown is served directly; no user-agent spoofing, browser rendering, or JavaScript is necessary.

## Start here

- [Canonical DESIGN.md contract](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/DESIGN.md): Agent-readable design rationale and Studio token snapshot generated from source CSS; other themes remain in CSS.
- [AI quickstart](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/ai-quickstart.md): Version-aware CSS installation and valid HTML examples.
- [Complete curated reference](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/llms-full.txt): Concatenated public technical guides, generated from source.
- [Agreed design principles and conformance](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/design-principles.md): Hierarchy, semantic components, states, native HTML recipes, and tested palette roles.
- [Component reference](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/components.md): Canonical low-entropy standard component inventory, native HTML controls (including range/file/color), CSS classes, semantic-mode boundaries and candidate-only table wrapping migration.
- [Component manifest](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/metadata/components.json): Curated, validated selectors with their required CSS modules.
- [WordPress](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/wordpress.md), [Shopify](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/shopify.md), [Wix](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/wix.md), [Webflow](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/webflow.md), [Framer](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/framer.md): practical platform integration guides (and 8 additional platform guides linked from the CMS overview).
- [CMS/site-builder integration](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/site-builders.md): WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Webflow, Framer, and other hosts; candidate-only unlayered embed CSS and editor/iframe boundaries.
- [Consumer agent skill](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/agents/syntyr/SKILL.md): Portable, opt-in instructions.
- [Contribution policy](https://github.com/dporkka/syntyr-css/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Public repository development, test, release and documentation rules.
- [Private security reporting](https://github.com/dporkka/syntyr-css/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub; never include exploits in public issues.

## FAQ and comparisons

- [FAQ](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/faq.md): Installation, licensing, browser-native behavior, frameworks and release compatibility.
- [CSS framework comparison hub](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/compare.md): Decision guide covering Tailwind, Bootstrap, shadcn/ui, daisyUI, Pico and plain CSS.

## Reference

- [Distribution and pinned CSS](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/distribution.md): Self-hosting, pinned asset URLs, and a downloadable offline SaaS demo in the **unreleased alpha.5** ZIP candidate (not in published alpha.4).
- [Cloudflare hosting and cache contract](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/cloudflare-hosting.md): Content-addressed website CSS, mutable preview URLs and immutable consumer releases.
- [Release freeze and exact-commit approval procedure](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/release-freeze.md): Maintainer-only human approval and evidence gates before freezing the unreleased alpha.5 candidate; technical preflight is not release authorization.
- [Public API stability](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/api-stability.md): Compatibility and release boundary.
- [Optional native animation companion](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/animation.md): Opt-in Web Animations API, stagger and viewport reveal helpers with reduced-motion support; **unreleased alpha.5**, never required by CSS core.
- [Composition recipes](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/recipes.md): Working responsive layouts and states.
- [Free Blocks and Assets guide](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/blocks-guide.md): Unreleased alpha.5 candidate with 40 copy-owned MIT sections and four static site starter pages; no required JavaScript or production backend.
- [Opt-in data-grid presentation](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/data-grid.md): Styling for host-owned data-grid behavior, ARIA states, and density (unreleased alpha.5 candidate).
- [Machine-readable composition recipe contracts](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/editor-integration.md): Validated component slots, variant values, stylesheet modules, and required application-owned behavior for AI agents and editors (unreleased alpha.5 source candidate).
- [Collection workspace and form-recovery example](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/examples/resource-workspace.html): Native GET filtering, tabular records and linked field errors; server actions and validation require integration (alpha.5 candidate).
- [Vertigo-inspired resource workflow HTML example](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/examples/vertigo-resource-workflow.html): Copyable index, detail, editor, and settings UI with fictional data and no runtime JavaScript.
- [Premium CSS-only compositions and browser validation](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/premium-compositions.md): SaaS surfaces, native command presentation, responsive layouts, and maintainer-only Chromium/Firefox/WebKit reflow, keyboard and axe verification (alpha.5 source candidate).
- [Copyable form recipes](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/component-recipes.md): Candidate-only native form groups and accessible markup.
- [Native patterns and component imports](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/native-patterns.md): Five native interaction recipes (accordion, GET search, dialog, datalist, meter/output), plus candidate-only browser recipes and individual CSS entrypoints; unreleased alpha.5 source.
- [Web Components authoring contract](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/component-authoring.md): Optional native Custom Elements and Lit interoperability; safe Declarative Shadow DOM upgrades, disabled no-JavaScript actions, live-region update discipline, and CSS-only core boundary (alpha.5 experimental examples).
- [Enterprise native data tables](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/data-tables.md): Optional sticky headers, zebra rows, keyboard scroll regions and aria-sort indicators; server owns sorting and filtering (alpha.5 candidate).
- [Pico.css migration and semantic starter](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/from-pico.md): Candidate-only one-file semantic bundle and migration cautions (not in alpha.4).
- [Optional Radix adapter](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/radix-integration.md): State-only styling for projects that already use Radix Primitives.
- [Framework integrations](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/framework-integrations.md): HTMX, server templates, React and other stacks.
- [Mobile and native UI integrations](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/mobile-frameworks.md): Opt-in source adapters for React Native / Expo and portable tokens for Flutter, SwiftUI, Compose, Ionic / Capacitor.
- [Theme tokens and customization](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/theme-customization.md): Supported design token overrides.
- [Visual-intensity and frame-composition guide](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/visual-intensity.md): Quiet, standard and cinematic effects; zero-JavaScript geometry rules (alpha.5 candidate).
- [Visual composition and flagship showcases](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/visual-composition.md): Premium restraint, accessible surfaces and responsive Studio, Noir and Grid page examples (alpha.5 candidate).
- [Optional advanced geometry guide](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/geometry-terminal.md): Seven frame shapes, per-corner cuts, gradient borders, inlays and integration boundaries (alpha.5 source candidate only).
- [Interactive geometry mixer](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/playground.html#geometry-title): Documentation-only editor with copyable HTML and no consumer runtime JavaScript (alpha.5 source candidate).
- [Accessibility guide](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/accessibility.md): Practical verification.
- [Alpha.5 accessibility review](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/accessibility-alpha5-review.md): Pinned automated evidence, unresolved contrast targets, and manual release gates.
- [Progressive CSS loading](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/progressive-loading.md): Selective CSS, critical CSS tradeoffs, and measured loading approaches.
- [Deployed mobile performance audit](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/live-performance-audit.md): Reproducible LCP, caching, CSP and accessibility evidence for the hosted business and SaaS examples.
- [Optional visualization styles](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/viz.md): SVG/HTML rendering and boundaries.
- [How to use Syntyr with coding agents](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/agent-integration.md): Recommended prompts, retrieval and validation.

## Commercial research (not for sale)

- [Syntyr Console Kit concept](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/console-kit.html): Separately authored, eight-screen private prototype with static screenshot previews and fictional data. **Not for sale:** no checkout, preorder, binding commercial license or working backend. The page offers a private preview request through the visitor's email app and a separate integration quote inquiry; neither is an order. All existing CSS, themes, components and public examples remain MIT licensed. Do not publish or claim access to the private kit source.
- [Product and proposed pricing overview](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/products.html): MIT core availability and not-for-sale premium product concepts only.
- [Commercial product metadata](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/metadata/commercial-offers.json): Machine-readable availability and research-only pricing hypotheses; never treat them as purchasable products.
